summary: Frontend-only verification of Evidence Locker delete fix on Expo web preview (375x667, logged out, scope 'device', PIN 1234, items seeded into IndexedDB 'dhara-local-recordings'). All requested flows PASS: confirmation dialog (recording-delete-dialog) shows title 'Delete this recording?' and exact sentence 'Once deleted, it cannot be retrieved.' with large Delete (52px, red) / Keep (52px) buttons; nothing deleted before confirm (verified in IDB); Keep and backdrop leave item intact; AUDIO, PHOTO, VIDEO and v2 SEGMENTED parent each deleted with toast 'Recording deleted from this device.'; segmented delete removed parent + both is_segment children and only its session record (TEST_ses1) while other session kept; deleted item's note removed, other notes untouched; manifest entry tombstoned (gps:null, deletedAt set, chainHash kept) while other entry untouched; reload + PIN shows only remaining items; forced IndexedDB failure shows in-dialog error 'Could not delete this recording (device storage). Nothing was removed — you can try again.' with no toast, and retry after restoring storage succeeds and clears error. Regression: note edit saves, PIN gate works, play/share/anchor/FIR/note buttons still rendered; delete while an item is playing works. Native path reviewed by code only.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Escape on web did not close the dialog in automation (onRequestClose is wired, so Android back should work; web-only, low priority).

issues: Body copy is redundant: 'This cannot be undone. Once deleted, it cannot be retrieved.' says the same thing twice — consider dropping 'This cannot be undone.' (required sentence must stay).

action_items: (Minor, native) evidenceStore.ts deleteRecording deletes files BEFORE writing the updated list to AsyncStorage; if setItem then fails the UI says 'Nothing was removed' although the file is already gone (row would remain pointing at a missing file). Consider writing the list first, then deleting files, or adjusting the message.
(Low) Remove redundant 'This cannot be undone.' from dialog body.
(Low, web) Escape key does not close delete dialog on web.
critical_code_review_comments: Native deleteRecording now guards `if (item.uri)` before new File(); v2 parent with uri '' no longer throws. Segment files deleted in per-file try/catch and stored list rewritten without parent + segments — CONFIRMED by code review (not runnable on web).
evidence-locker.tsx is 1173 lines (>700) — should be split (pre-existing).
deleteSession and markManifestDeleted failures are swallowed with .catch(()=>{}) — acceptable, but a stale session record could later surface as 'recoverable' if deleteSession fails.
Web v2 delete rejects with 'Could not delete.' which maps to reason class 'unexpected error' rather than 'device storage' — cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 low web-only Escape issue)

seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed IndexedDB rows, notes, session and manifest entries were seeded only inside ephemeral Playwright browser contexts (no server/DB data created; nothing persists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh context — seed IDB + localStorage (gk_consent_version='2026-10-01', evidence_notes_device, dhara_evidence_sessions_v1_device, dhara_evidence_manifest_v1_device) in the same script. PIN flow: create -> confirm (enter 1234 twice) on first open, single entry after reload. Failure can be forced by overriding IDBFactory.prototype.open to fire onerror. Playback of seeded fake bytes shows 'Playback could not start' — expected, not a regression.
